page.layout: One column of Hebrew index entries with page references to the right, in alphabetical order, with brace-joined pairs and gaps between letter groups; a Hebrew word in the left margin at the foot; running head at top centre.
page.notes: The Hebrew entries are set in a brace-joined pair at "סגר / הסגיר" and "עמים / לאמים"; the order of the two words in each pair follows the visual arrangement and may need checking against the original. The Hebrew word פוץ in the left margin at the foot is set apart from the entries and is given as a margin note beside the last entry. No page number or signature is printed. Some page numerals are in old-style figures and are copied as printed.
